Perfect! All tests pass. The fix was straightforward:

1. Changed the regex from `r"[^a-z0-9]"` to `r"[^a-z0-9]+"` to match runs of non-alphanumeric characters (not just individual characters)
2. Added `.strip("-")` to remove any leading or trailing dashes

Now `slugify('Hello,  World!')` correctly returns `'hello-world'` instead of `'hello---world-'`.
